senses.gloss: घटा ghaṭ-ā, f. multitude, host, troop.

घट्ट ghaṭṭ-a, m. shock, collision;
 landing-stair, 🞄bathing-place: -jīvin, m. ferryman.

घट्टन ghaṭṭ-ana, n. stroke, contact;
 stirring.
घटयितव्य ghaṭ-ay-i-tavya, fp. to be joined 🞄or closed.
घटादि ghaṭ-ādi, pl. the gaṇa beginning 🞄with ghaṭ (gr.).
घटिका ghaṭ-ikā, f. pot, jar, pitcher.

घटोत्कच ghaṭa‿utkaca, m. N. of a Rākṣasa;
 🞄-ūdhnī, f. having a jar-shaped udder (cow).
